svg.title: Closed polyhedron from face areas and outward normals
svg.desc: A tetrahedron with four outward face-area vectors whose weighted sum closes, alongside the Minkowski reconstruction condition.
svg.text: A closed polyhedron starts with balanced face vectors
Classical geometry input: positive face areas and outward unit normals
Arrows schematically show outward face-area vectors.
normals are unit vectors and close
not a claim of sharp quantum
face fluxes in an FL state.
